reviewedRevision: b31102f7 (accepted build) plus the fixes in this commit
reviewer: weight-fair, weight-robust and weight-present (parallel split review)
process: Lean final review at the user's request, with the review split across three parallel reviewers (fairness, robustness, presentation) as the user asked. The game already had 24 machines; robustness passed outright. Three MEDIUM findings and two LOW items were fixed and verified by a separate verification agent re-running the reviewers' probes against the repository files (with the owner's copies adapted to request the now opt-in hint and to read the budget once the optimal count is hidden) plus one clean-worktree run, then by the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: Every machine still has exactly one solution and fits its budget. On the final files a reaction-limited bot that buys the opt-in hint cleared all 24 machines at 0.25 s and 0.35 s, needing no hints on machines 1-7 and 5-17 per machine from machine 8, where the review had found the always-on hint solving every machine at optimal moves for free. Blind policies cleared nothing, scripted play matched across 30, 60 and 120 Hz, hostile input produced no throws or NaN, a hint-buying bot won through all 24 machines, every broken progress store was safe, and EN and ZH text fits with no untranslated units.

findings.observation: Fairness finding: the hint always showed the exact peg, key and mass for the unique solution, and the budget left a flat 2 spare moves, so following it cleared every machine and mastery was trivial. Machines 1-7 keep step hints; from machine 8 the line states the goal ('Balance every beam') and H or the Hint touch button reveals the next move for 12 points; getState exposes the solution only while shown; machines 17-24 allow one spare move.

Presentation findings: Chinese advice lines and rope labels showed 'kg', and the machine picker marked locked and selected machines by colour alone. Chinese text now uses 千克, locked machines show a padlock and the selected machine has corner brackets.
Arrow, WASD, Z, X and Q presses now skip the 1.8 s clear pause instead of being dropped, and inactive tippers carry a cross rather than only lower opacity.

openNotes: A player can still buy every hint; the cost is score, not progress.
The visible checks of the padlock and tipper cross were done in the browser at menu and play-screen level only.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start and the language toggle, synthetic in-page keys driven by the status line; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened machine 1 of 24 (First Balance) with the beam, pegs, gate lamp, tray and the teaching hint 'Move → 2 to beam A peg +3'; the description explained that hints are bought with H from machine 8.
Win: following the prompts placed the 2 kg mass, the needles settled ('Machine balanced! The next one is coming') and machine 2 (Two Masses) opened.

Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the machine picker in Chinese with padlocks on locked machines, corner brackets on the selection and touch buttons 左, 右, 上, 下, 拿放, 托盘, 撤销, 重置 and 提示.
Not covered in the browser: a bought hint, a tipper and the final machine; the probes and quality tests cover them.
